rule: Our own split (the upstream split lists are not copied). Per user, sessions in name order (names start with the date). Users with >= 4 sessions: last -> test, second last -> val, the rest -> train. Users with < 4 sessions: all -> train. Local id = session name. Payload = file size | keystrokes | prompts (metadata.csv).

units.session: one session file <session>.hdf5 (all prompts of that session)
